market_summary: U.S. and regional markets faced headwinds on Nov 11 as Nvidia shares sank more than 9% after reports the board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang over personal misconduct matters, roiling semiconductor and tech stocks. Singapore's banking sector showed mixed Q3 results, with OCBC beating forecasts but DBS and UOB missing expectations amid margin pressures and equity market weakness. Meanwhile, Singapore Airlines reported a 43.9% profit decline in H1 FY2026/27 despite record revenue, hit hard by jet fuel costs tied to Middle East conflict escalation. Asian markets digest uncertainty over geopolitical risks and energy prices, while U.S. tech earnings continue to influence investor sentiment.

items.headline: Nvidia preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang after affairs, board to meet as soon as Wednesday
items.summary: Nvidia's board is preparing to remove co-founder CEO Jensen Huang following revelations of two extramarital affairs, one involving a suspected Chinese spy. Shares fell more than 9% in after-hours trading.

items.headline: Singapore Airlines H1 FY2026/27 net profit falls 43.9% to S$134m amid elevated fuel costs
items.summary: SIA Group's net profit dropped 43.9% to S$134 million in first half due to jet fuel prices surging 86.7% year-over-year from West Asia conflict, despite record H1 revenue of S$11.3 billion.

items.headline: OCBC reports Q3 net profit of S$2.04 billion, beats expectations as only Singapore bank to do so
items.summary: OCBC posted Q3 net profit of S$2.04 billion, up 3% year-on-year, beating the S$2.00 billion consensus. Banking operations reached record S$1.90 billion on strong loan growth and customer trading income.

items.headline: DBS Q3 net profit falls 5% to S$2.81 billion, misses forecasts as market volatility hits trading income
items.summary: DBS Group's Q3 net profit declined 5% to S$2.81 billion, missing the S$2.90 billion consensus estimate, due to 65% drop in markets trading income amid unfavorable equity market conditions.

items.headline: Apple reports Q4 FY2026 revenue of $114.5 billion, beats EPS estimates at $2.10
items.summary: Apple posted fiscal Q4 revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12% YoY, with diluted EPS of $2.10 beating the $1.99 consensus. iPhone reached September quarter record and Services hit all-time high.
